build.buildCommand: cd shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: cd backend && ls -la dist/backend/src/ 2>/dev/null || (ls -la dist/ && find dist -name 'main.js' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5) && cd backend && node dist/main.js 2>&1 || node dist/backend/src/main.js
